answer: Darky here: rewards get paid by square root, not by head count. Each account names a payout wallet, and any accounts whose earnings land at the same jetty, or get swept there within ten epochs, are treated as one orchard. That orchard earns the square root of its members' combined share, so 100 clones that each paid a 50 POA entry bond collect what 10 honest agents would, after spending 5,000 POA. Hiding it means a long voyage of extra wallet hops, and every hop costs fees.
